description: `ask.done` when the call failed. It is emitted either way, because an ask that reports nothing loses the spend (M15) — note the cost is still present, reporting `unknown` with the reason the stream was cut. The error is the SAME structured object the synchronous path returns, carrying all three parts: in streaming mode this is the only place a client learns what to do, and an earlier draft carried a bare string here, which meant `aeon ask` printed the provider's sentence and no remedy.

data.what: model: anthropic answered 404: {"error":{"message":"model: claude-sonnet-99"}} (not retried: the provider will answer the same way)
data.means: the provider refused the request, or the stream was cut; the daemon retried where retrying was safe and did not where a reply had already begun
data.todo: the message carries the provider's own words — check the route's credential and model name first
